technical_change: SailPoint CLI 2.8.0 adds a new `scope` command, makes OAuth scopes optional (PowerShell scopes are now read from a file instead of being hardcoded), updates connector subcommands to use the latest available API, and adds agent-skills setup for managed and unmanaged UI plugins. CLI terminology shifts from "ISC" toward "Identity Security" / "SHF" when describing a tenant.
who_is_affected: Customers and partners automating SailPoint Identity Security Cloud via the public CLI/SDKs.
implementation_impact: Low — additive CLI tooling change; the release page states no breaking change or deprecation.
